description: This file defines a servlet filter class 'CatalogUrlFilter' responsible for handling URL processing, routing, and trail management for product and category pages within an e-commerce application's catalog subsystem. It manages URL rewriting, trail generation, and forwarding requests to appropriate handlers.

classes.name: CatalogUrlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter that intercepts requests for catalog URLs, interprets URL path components to identify products or categories, builds URL trails, and forwards requests to the appropriate controllers. Also provides static methods for URL generation based on product or category data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Intercepts HTTP requests, parses URL paths, performs database lookups for products and categories, manages URL trails, and forwards or continues processing as needed.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is taken out of service.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL for a category based on request context and category/product IDs.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl (overloaded)
methods.description: Constructs a category URL using detailed parameters, possibly including URL parameters like view size, index, sorting, and search string.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Generates a product URL based on request context and product IDs.

methods.name: makeProductUrl (overloaded)
methods.description: Constructs a product URL using detailed parameters, including optional URL parameters.

methods.name: getDefaultLocaleString
methods.description: Returns the default locale string configured for URL handling.

methods.name: setDefaultLocaleString
methods.description: Sets the default locale string for URL handling.
